• Camera distance

• Focal length characteristics

• Object placement
• Scale

Preserve:

• Light direction
• Light intensity
• Exposure
• White balance
• Contrast
• Ambient illumination
• Color temperature
• Shadow direction
• Shadow softness
• Reflections

• Reflections

• Color interaction
• Depth relationships

Treat Image 2 exclusively as a photographic reference.

Never transfer from Image 2:

• Facial proportions
• Hair
• Hair color
• Skin tone
• Body shape
• Body proportions
• Clothing
• Accessories
• Jewelry
• Makeup

• Composition
• Framing
• Subject placement
• Pose
• Environment
• Lighting
